newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB squeezed higher amid option interest.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB squeezed higher amid option interest.

text.p: Shares in satellite broadcaster BSkyB Plc were squeezed higher in late morning on Friday amid buying interest in the option market, traders said.
BSkyB added 22-1/2p to 647-1/2p, with stock shortages exaggerating the upward pressure on the stock.

"We're seeing a reasonable sized buyer in the options and no-one one wants to take him on. The stock is just getting called up and called up and there are few people in pain out there," said one dealer.
The shares broke through 600p for the first time last week with dealers then highlighting a chart break-out.
The shares are up 47 percent since the beginning of July.
